description: Follow baseball with API-Baseball: games and live scores by inning, standings, team season statistics, head-to-head records and bookmakers' pre-match odds, for MLB, Japan's NPB, Korea's KBO, Taiwan's CPBL, winter leagues and international cups. Needs an API-SPORTS key; the free plan allows 100 requests a day.
